data.title: The Celts in the Lesser Carpathians – a lecture by R. Čambal
data.excerpt: The Slovak National Museum in Bratislava and our civic association Hradiská organised a lecture by the archaeologist Radoslav Čambal on the Celts in the Lesser Carpathians. It was held in Dolné Orešany on 28 July 2017 and the turnout was really high.
data.metaTitle: The Celts in the Lesser Carpathians – a lecture
data.metaDescription: A lecture by the archaeologist Radoslav Čambal on the Celts in the Lesser Carpathians, held in Dolné Orešany in July 2017 by the museum and Hradiská.

children.text: The Slovak National Museum in Bratislava, in cooperation with our civic association Hradiská, organised an interesting lecture by the archaeologist Mgr. Radoslav Čambal entitled “Kelti v Malých Karpatoch” (The Celts in the Lesser Carpathians). It was held on Friday 28 July 2017 at 5 p.m. in Dolné Orešany.
As can be seen from the photographs, the turnout was really high. Thanks to everyone who came. A great deal of work for the association was done by
, without whom the event would not have taken place. Thanks are also due to the mayor of Dolné Orešany for providing the premises and for her helpfulness and cooperation.
